resolution_rules.failure_mechanism: Airtable puts table design, field typing, and view structure in front of first useful capture.
resolution_rules.failure_trigger: Database fields and table structure must be configured before use.
resolution_rules.survival_reason: Trello lets the user create a board and move cards immediately without designing a data model first.
resolution_rules.tradeoff_introduced: Trello gives up richer fields, stronger structure, and multiple ways to organize the same work later.

resolution_rules.failure_mechanism: Todoist keeps shared work in a lighter list model where assignee visibility is weaker in the main scan path.
resolution_rules.failure_trigger: Tracking tasks cannot clearly assign ownership and responsibility across team members.
resolution_rules.survival_reason: Asana keeps assignees visible inside shared project views so ownership can be scanned without opening items.
resolution_rules.tradeoff_introduced: Asana adds project structure and team-focused surfaces that can feel heavier for simple personal tracking.

resolution_rules.failure_mechanism: Sunsama makes daily usefulness depend on a recurring planning ritual instead of leaving lists stable between sessions.
resolution_rules.failure_trigger: Daily planning is required to function.
resolution_rules.survival_reason: Apple Reminders keeps tasks usable as simple persistent lists with no required daily setup cycle.
resolution_rules.tradeoff_introduced: Apple Reminders gives up the intentional daily scheduling layer that can help when planning itself is the point.

resolution_rules.failure_mechanism: ClickUp surrounds a basic checklist job with multiple views, dashboards, and configuration panels that create extra decisions.
resolution_rules.failure_trigger: Multiple views and configuration panels add extra decisions.
resolution_rules.survival_reason: Apple Reminders keeps the task surface close to a plain checklist with minimal interface branching.
resolution_rules.tradeoff_introduced: Apple Reminders tops out sooner when the workflow genuinely needs dashboards, deeper views, or heavier task structure.

resolution_rules.failure_mechanism: Microsoft To Do stays simple by omitting contexts, perspectives, and review automation that a strict GTD system depends on.
resolution_rules.failure_trigger: Contexts, perspectives, and review automation are structurally limited.
resolution_rules.survival_reason: OmniFocus survives by supporting the workflow layers that let a complex GTD system keep scaling without workarounds.
resolution_rules.tradeoff_introduced: OmniFocus introduces more setup depth and process than a simple list tool needs.

resolution_rules.failure_mechanism: Logseq exposes local folders, graph files, and plugin concepts before the note habit is established.
resolution_rules.failure_trigger: Local file setup and plugin concepts must be understood first.
resolution_rules.survival_reason: Apple Notes opens directly to a synced note list so capture happens before system-building decisions.
resolution_rules.tradeoff_introduced: Apple Notes gives up deeper linking, plugin extensibility, and custom knowledge-system behavior.

resolution_rules.failure_mechanism: Joplin asks for sync-method and markdown-system decisions that pay back over a longer horizon than a semester note need.
resolution_rules.failure_trigger: Setup effort outweighs semester value.
resolution_rules.survival_reason: Apple Notes delivers useful note capture immediately without asking the student to design or maintain a system first.
resolution_rules.tradeoff_introduced: Apple Notes gives up some longer-term sync and markdown control if the note base later needs to become more durable or portable.

resolution_rules.failure_mechanism: Apple Notes keeps note structure shallow and closed, so graph linking and plugin extension cannot absorb a true second-brain workflow.
resolution_rules.failure_trigger: Graph linking and plugin extensibility are constrained.
resolution_rules.survival_reason: Obsidian survives by giving local Markdown storage, bidirectional links, and a plugin path that expands with the system.
resolution_rules.tradeoff_introduced: Obsidian introduces more setup, customization, and system-maintenance overhead than a simpler notes app.

resolution_rules.failure_mechanism: Notion routes plain writing through workspace pages and a block editor that add interface layers before the note itself.
resolution_rules.failure_trigger: Writing a note requires interacting with block editors or workspace pages instead of a plain text field.
resolution_rules.survival_reason: Simplenote survives by opening directly to a plain text surface with almost no structural overhead.
resolution_rules.tradeoff_introduced: Simplenote gives up richer pages, databases, and structured workspace behavior once the note job becomes more than plain text capture.

resolution_rules.failure_mechanism: Obsidian leaves note state dependent on folder setup and optional sync configuration that the user has to interpret correctly.
resolution_rules.failure_trigger: Syncing notes requires configuring folders or third-party sync services instead of working automatically.
resolution_rules.survival_reason: Simplenote survives because sync behavior is automatic and legible without storage or folder decisions.
resolution_rules.tradeoff_introduced: Simplenote gives up deeper local control and extensibility in exchange for safer default behavior.

resolution_rules.failure_mechanism: Toggl Track gates basic logging behind account creation and cloud workspace access before the timer can feel routine.
resolution_rules.failure_trigger: Tracking time requires creating an account or logging into a cloud service before use.
resolution_rules.survival_reason: OfficeTime survives by opening as a local desktop tracker that can be used immediately after install.
resolution_rules.tradeoff_introduced: OfficeTime gives up some browser access and multi-device convenience that a cloud workspace can provide.

resolution_rules.failure_mechanism: Clockify makes a personal tracker depend on a maintained cloud account and sync state instead of disappearing into local use.
resolution_rules.failure_trigger: Tracking time requires creating and maintaining a cloud account with ongoing sync.
resolution_rules.survival_reason: ActivityWatch survives by running locally and offline without credentials or sync babysitting.
resolution_rules.tradeoff_introduced: ActivityWatch gives up easy browser access and multi-device visibility when the same records need to be reached elsewhere.

resolution_rules.failure_mechanism: RescueTime converts time logging into a later review-and-categorize step, so billable records depend on cleanup after the work.
resolution_rules.failure_trigger: Logging time requires reviewing and categorizing automatic activity reports instead of quickly starting a timer.
resolution_rules.survival_reason: Clockify survives by letting the user record time in a direct start-stop path that fits fast meeting-to-meeting work.
resolution_rules.tradeoff_introduced: Clockify gives up passive background reconstruction and depends more on explicit user initiation.

resolution_rules.failure_mechanism: Accelo wraps simple tracking in CRM, project, and billing modules that have to be navigated before the timer job is done.
resolution_rules.failure_trigger: Tracking time requires navigating CRM, project, or billing modules instead of a simple timer workflow.
resolution_rules.survival_reason: Toggl Track survives by keeping the core action close to a clean timer without surrounding business-system layers.
resolution_rules.tradeoff_introduced: Toggl Track gives up the integrated CRM and billing depth that can matter once time tracking is part of a larger operations stack.

resolution_rules.failure_mechanism: Toggl Track leaves record completeness dependent on repeated timer starts and stops, so the capture model tops out under fast switching.
resolution_rules.failure_trigger: Tracking time requires manually starting and stopping timers instead of automatic app-based tracking.
resolution_rules.survival_reason: Timing survives by automatically capturing app, document, and browsing context so the timeline keeps detail without manual babysitting.
resolution_rules.tradeoff_introduced: Timing gives up some explicit timer control and is less compelling when the work is already neatly bounded and intentionally declared by hand.

resolution_rules.failure_mechanism: Kimai turns a personal tracker into a maintained web stack by requiring a server and database.
resolution_rules.failure_trigger: Using the tool requires maintaining a self-hosted web server and database instead of running locally with minimal setup.
resolution_rules.survival_reason: ManicTime survives by running locally as a desktop app with no server infrastructure to care for.
resolution_rules.tradeoff_introduced: ManicTime gives up the self-hosted web model when remote access or broader environment control becomes more important.

resolution_rules.failure_mechanism: Outlook Calendar exposes account lists and folder concepts before the user can treat the app as a plain event calendar.
resolution_rules.failure_trigger: Folder and account management must be understood before basic event entry.
resolution_rules.survival_reason: Apple Calendar survives by presenting a direct event-entry surface without requiring the user to reason about folder structure first.
resolution_rules.tradeoff_introduced: Apple Calendar gives up some of the heavier account and workflow structure that can matter in more complex enterprise scheduling contexts.

resolution_rules.failure_mechanism: Notion Calendar pulls workspace databases and task layers into what this comparison treats as a basic event-viewing job.
resolution_rules.failure_trigger: Workspace databases and task layers introduce extra interface complexity.
resolution_rules.survival_reason: Apple Calendar survives by staying close to a straightforward event timeline with minimal surrounding structure.
resolution_rules.tradeoff_introduced: Apple Calendar gives up the tighter workspace coupling that can matter once calendar behavior needs to connect deeply to a broader system.

resolution_rules.failure_mechanism: Setmore separates booking from checkout, forcing payment to be handed off across systems after the slot is chosen.
resolution_rules.failure_trigger: Appointment scheduling cannot integrate directly with payment processing and checkout.
resolution_rules.survival_reason: Square Appointments survives by keeping booking and payment in one operational flow instead of splitting the transaction.
resolution_rules.tradeoff_introduced: Square Appointments becomes heavier than necessary when appointments are not tied to paid services or checkout flows.

resolution_rules.failure_mechanism: Superhuman keeps normal inbox use dependent on a live connection, so access reliability becomes part of the workflow cost.
resolution_rules.failure_trigger: Email access depends on a constant internet connection instead of local offline storage and syncing.
resolution_rules.survival_reason: Apple Mail survives by keeping messages locally available so reading, searching, and composing remain predictable offline.
resolution_rules.tradeoff_introduced: Apple Mail gives up some of the speed-optimized online workflow design that Superhuman prioritizes when connectivity is stable.

resolution_rules.failure_mechanism: Microsoft Teams hides conversations behind layered teams, channels, and tabs that increase navigation before the next reply.
resolution_rules.failure_trigger: Finding the right conversation requires navigating layered teams, channels, and tabs instead of a fast searchable message flow.
resolution_rules.survival_reason: Slack survives by keeping communication in a faster searchable stream with lower path length between conversations.
resolution_rules.tradeoff_introduced: Slack gives up some of the heavier surrounding workspace structure that Teams can provide in more integrated enterprise environments.

resolution_rules.failure_mechanism: Slack keeps data location, system behavior, and environment control inside a hosted provider boundary.
resolution_rules.failure_trigger: Data cannot be self-hosted and fully controlled within your own infrastructure.
resolution_rules.survival_reason: Mattermost survives by allowing self-hosting so infrastructure, compliance, and integrations can be controlled internally.
resolution_rules.tradeoff_introduced: Mattermost requires the user to own infrastructure, maintenance, and operational responsibility.

resolution_rules.failure_mechanism: Microsoft Excel leaves structure correctness dependent on fragile cells and formulas that can be altered accidentally.
resolution_rules.failure_trigger: Managing data requires maintaining fragile cell formulas instead of enforced field types.
resolution_rules.survival_reason: Airtable survives by enforcing field types and keeping structure more legible during ordinary edits.
resolution_rules.tradeoff_introduced: Airtable gives up some spreadsheet freedom and formula-style flexibility in exchange for safer structured defaults.

resolution_rules.failure_mechanism: Baserow introduces environment and hosting decisions before the beginner can treat the database as an immediately usable cloud tool.
resolution_rules.failure_trigger: Using the tool requires self-hosting or server setup instead of instant cloud access.
resolution_rules.survival_reason: Airtable survives by being hosted and ready for immediate table creation without infrastructure decisions.
resolution_rules.tradeoff_introduced: Airtable gives up some open-source and self-managed flexibility that Baserow can offer once setup cost is acceptable.

resolution_rules.failure_mechanism: KeePass leaves vault availability tied to manually managed local files and sync arrangements across browsers and devices.
resolution_rules.failure_trigger: Using the password manager requires manually managing vault files instead of automatic cloud syncing and autofill.
resolution_rules.survival_reason: 1Password survives by keeping sync and autofill automatic so repeated login work stays fast across contexts.
resolution_rules.tradeoff_introduced: 1Password gives up the fully local file-based model and depends more on an account-backed managed service.

resolution_rules.failure_mechanism: KeePassXC turns cross-device password availability into a user-managed file-sync problem that can be misconfigured or forgotten.
resolution_rules.failure_trigger: Syncing passwords requires configuring external cloud storage or manually transferring database files.
resolution_rules.survival_reason: NordPass survives by making multi-device vault sync automatic and predictable inside the account model.
resolution_rules.tradeoff_introduced: NordPass gives up the fully local database approach and some user-controlled storage flexibility.

resolution_rules.failure_mechanism: Google Chat lets discussion float as standalone threads, so users have to reconstruct how messages relate to the actual work.
resolution_rules.failure_trigger: Messages exist as standalone chat threads instead of being anchored to projects and work context.
resolution_rules.survival_reason: Basecamp survives by anchoring discussion inside project surfaces where the surrounding work context is already present.
resolution_rules.tradeoff_introduced: Basecamp gives up some of the lighter pure-chat feel when the user only wants fast standalone conversation.

resolution_rules.failure_mechanism: Trello's card model runs out of room when tasks need richer repeatable fields and more structured views of the same work.
resolution_rules.failure_trigger: Custom task fields and structured board data are constrained.
resolution_rules.survival_reason: Monday.com survives by attaching richer structured properties to each task so the same system can scale without manual rebuilds.
resolution_rules.tradeoff_introduced: Monday.com becomes the wrong fit when every extra field feels like unnecessary system design for a plain task list.

resolution_rules.failure_mechanism: Linear routes simple personal capture through issue-tracking concepts like issues and cycles that add context selection before entry.
resolution_rules.failure_trigger: Issue-tracking concepts slow simple task entry.
resolution_rules.survival_reason: Todoist survives by keeping personal task capture close to a simple list where entry can happen in seconds.
resolution_rules.tradeoff_introduced: Todoist gives up some of the richer issue-tracking structure that Linear provides when the work becomes more systematized.

resolution_rules.failure_mechanism: Slack turns communication into a continuous real-time stream that must be monitored instead of letting attention return to the work.
resolution_rules.failure_trigger: Communication requires continuous real-time monitoring instead of allowing structured check-ins.
resolution_rules.survival_reason: Basecamp survives by structuring updates and discussions for batch review rather than constant interruption.
resolution_rules.tradeoff_introduced: Basecamp gives up some real-time chat immediacy when fast live conversation is genuinely the priority.
